reviews.title: Memory photo book
reviews.text: I would love to give an honest review of this product but it HASN’T arrived. I purchased it for my terminally ill wife for her birthday on 25th July. I paid for the upgrade on postage for it arrive on 23/24 July. Guess what it’s the 26 th July and still not arrived. It’s obviously too late now, in more ways than one, so I think at the very least I should be refunded my extra postage cost or even the full cost of the order. I am very disappointed!!!!!

reviews.title: Unusable after update
reviews.text: This was my favourite photobook app, it used to add photos one per page, now it collates them automatically (and does a poor job) so you have to undo that before you can start. Also just discovered it doesn’t automatically save your changes, it’s reset twice, losing everything I’ve done. App is now unusable. Please change it back and just leave it alone! It was fine before.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My books arrived and they are lovely quality but the images in the 2 separate books I ordered have been muddled up. 
Mistakes happen I'm understanding and the support team were quick to respond. 
However, they have told me they can not reprint my order and only give me a refund. To get the refund I'll have to get to a post office to return the books first. 
I'd have much preferred a reprint and not having to inconvenience myself for someone else's mistake

reviews.title: Late delivery and backtracked on refund!!
reviews.text:
My delivery was meant to be 7th Feb and it came on 9th Feb. Worst thing was the communication. You’d expect them to be responsive and respectful to this. No. The customer service said my order would come on the 11th!!! Past the time I even need it for. No acknowledgement of issue, no incentive for a refund, nothing. Disgraceful. Don’t use.

Edit: they replied to this review stating they’ll honour a refund. However when I emailed about it.. they said they couldn’t give me one as they can’t find my order. This is a total lie as I had sent them my order number. I can give them my bank details. On top of all that - they also have the whole email thread of them literally ADMITTING to my order being late but not doing anything about it apart from writing a lying reply to my review then backtracking. They could just look at those emails and find my order that way. Or just ask for my bank details it’s not that hard.

They are just trying to make it seem like they will rectify situation just to look good on reviews but when speaking one to one - they do nothing. Will not be using, I suggest you don’t either, just use other more popular apps. 🙂
